description:
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Accursed Centaur ability.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel
